title: pademinune's Armor Penetration Calculator
armor_label.title: Enable Armor Label
armor_label.tooltip_body: Show or hide the effective armor value label.
prob_label.title: Enable Probability Label
prob_label.tooltip_body: Show or hide the penetration probability label.
angle_label.title: Enable Angle Label
angle_label.tooltip_body: Show or hide the impact angle label.
angle_label.display_threshold.title: Angle Display Threshold
angle_label.display_threshold.tooltip_bo: The minimum impact angle (in degrees) at which the angle label is shown. Set to 0 to always show it.
angle_label.always_white.title: Angle Color is always White
angle_label.always_white.tooltip_body: Toggle between having the angle label color always be White, or to mimic the penetration chance color.
colors.high_chance.title: High Pen Chance
colors.high_chance.tooltip_body: Color shown when penetration probability is high (>93%).
colors.medium_chance.title: Medium Pen Chance
colors.medium_chance.tooltip_body: Color shown when penetration probability is medium.
colors.low_chance.title: Low Pen Chance
colors.low_chance.tooltip_body: Color shown when penetration probability is low (<7%).
colors.ricochet.title: Ricochet
colors.ricochet.tooltip_body: Color shown when the shell will ricochet.
colorblind.enabled.title: Use colorblind colors
colorblind.enabled.tooltip_body: Swap to a colorblind-safe color scheme, editable below.
colors.gradient.title: Use gradient colors
colors.gradient.tooltip_body: Smoothly fade the penetration chance color between the low, medium, and high colors instead of switching between them abruptly.
discord_button.title: Discord
discord_button.tooltip_body: Join the Discord for updates, bug reports, and feature requests.
donate_button.title: Donate
donate_button.tooltip_body: If the calculator's been useful, a donation helps cover the time spent maintaining and improving it.
